method: SORTED BY EYE FROM THE CONTACT SHEETS ALONE, BEFORE ANY METRIC WAS OPENED. Six sheets of twelve (docs/qa/battle-placement/sheets/sheet0*.png), each cell the shipped establishing shot ('round', show:'all') of a real battle staged by the shipped stageArena at that site, photographed through the stage's own snapshot() so the bytes are the player's pipeline. The only numbers seen before the sort were the four progress columns the capture tool prints per site (edgeRGB / topSurface / skyFrac / zone) as they scrolled past; the bundle in sites.json was not read until this file existed.

rubric.good: all four bodies read immediately as separate figures; what is behind them differs from them in value or is open; the ground plane reads; no single surface owns the frame
rubric.acceptable: readable but compromised — one side of the cast is low-contrast, or one surface owns half the frame, or the place is odd but legible
rubric.bad: a body is effectively lost (inside foliage, or at its background's own value, or in near-black), or one surface owns the frame with nothing else in it, or the party is in a hole / on a roof / behind clutter
